classification.difficultyReason: Compare routes by inspection on a six-vertex weighted network, including routes through intermediate vertices.

content.prompt: Determine the lengths of the shortest paths between the given vertices by inspection.

spec.description: Six-vertex undirected network. Diagonals AD and BC cross without a vertex. Ordinary source blue edges and red vertex markers use house black.
spec.mathematics: XA=8, XB=10, AC=11, AD=11, BC=7, BD=9, CY=9, DY=8. There are no other edges.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied vertices, edges and weights are visible.

answer.worked:
The shortest route is $X-B-C$.
$$8+11=19,\qquad 10+7=17.$$
The shortest-path length is $17$.

The routes $X-A-D$ and $X-B-D$ have equal minimum length.
$$8+11=19,\qquad 10+9=19.$$
The shortest-path length is $19$.

Compare $A-C-Y$ and $A-D-Y$:
$$11+9=20,\qquad 11+8=19.$$
The shortest route is $A-D-Y$, with length $19$.

Compare $B-C-Y$ and $B-D-Y$:
$$7+9=16,\qquad 9+8=17.$$
The shortest route is $B-C-Y$, with length $16$.

Compare routes through $X$, $C$ and $D$:
$$8+10=18,\qquad 11+7=18,\qquad 11+9=20.$$
Both $A-X-B$ and $A-C-B$ have the minimum length $18$.

Compare the direct routes across the network:
$$\begin{aligned}X-A-C-Y &: 8+11+9=28\\X-A-D-Y &: 8+11+8=27\\X-B-C-Y &: 10+7+9=26\\X-B-D-Y &: 10+9+8=27.\end{aligned}$$
Longer detours do not reduce these totals. The shortest route is $X-B-C-Y$, with length $26$.
